map.→ 打开催化剂用量与反应时间工具: -> Open the catalyst loading and reaction time tool
map.停留时间校核：给定目标停留时间(秒)反算所需催化剂量与等效空速，用于技术改造或切: Residence time check: given a target residence time (seconds), back out the required catalyst loading and equivalent space velocity for a quick estimate when retrofitting or switching catalysts.
map.储罐容量与液位换算: Tank capacity and liquid level conversion
map.催化剂体积 = 进料体积流量 ÷ 空速；再乘以堆密度得质量(kg)。进料体积流量: Catalyst volume = feed volumetric flow ÷ space velocity; multiply by bulk density to get mass (kg). Feed volumetric flow = mass flow ÷ feed density. Residence time = 3600 ÷ space velocity (seconds).
map.催化剂用量与反应时间 使用指南: Catalyst loading and reaction time user guide
map.催化剂装量怎么由空速得到？: How do you get the catalyst loading from space velocity?
map.催化剂采购与装填：由体积×堆密度得质量(kg)，结合单批价格估算采购量，避免多买: Catalyst purchasing and filling: get mass (kg) from volume × bulk density and combine it with the unit price to estimate purchase quantity, avoiding over-buying or under-filling that would affect the start of production.
map.固定床反应器设计：按进料质量流量与空速(LHSV)反推催化剂装填体积与质量，空速: Fixed-bed reactor design: back out catalyst filling volume and mass from feed mass flow and space velocity (LHSV); a smaller space velocity means a longer residence and higher conversion but a larger vessel.
map.液时空速 LHSV = 进料体积流量 / 催化剂体积（单位 h⁻¹），表示每小时: Liquid hourly space velocity LHSV = feed volumetric flow / catalyst volume (unit h⁻¹), meaning the material passing "one catalyst volume" per hour. The smaller the LHSV, the longer the residence time and generally the higher the conversion.
map.算例：空速模式与时间模式各一例: Worked examples: one space velocity mode and one time mode
map.输入进料体积流量与空速 LHSV（或停留时间），工具反算所需催化剂装填体积与单程: Enter the feed volumetric flow and space velocity LHSV (or residence time), and the tool back-solves the required catalyst filling volume and single-pass reaction time; it can also derive space velocity from catalyst volume and feed, assisting fixed-bed reactor packing and process condition design.
map.：空速模式：进料 1000 kg/h、LHSV=2 h⁻¹、原料密度 800、堆:
: space velocity mode: feed 1000 kg/h, LHSV=2 h⁻¹, feed density 800, bulk density 700. Volumetric flow=1000/800=1.2500 m³/h; catalyst volume=1.25/2=0.6250 m³; mass=0.6250×700=437.5 kg; residence time=3600/2=1800 s.
time mode: feed 1000 kg/h, target residence 1800 s, density 800, bulk density 700. Volumetric flow=1.2500 m³/h; catalyst volume=(1.25/3600)×1800=0.6250 m³; mass=437.5 kg; equivalent space velocity=3600/1800=2.000 h⁻¹. The two modes agree under consistent parameters.
